definition: MERN Capstone is a core concept in MERN Stack. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What MERN Capstone is
theory.body: MERN Capstone describes the methods and patterns used within MERN Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: MERN Capstone is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why MERN Capstone matters
theory.body: Without MERN Capstone, systems built with MERN Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MERN Capstone works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MERN Capstone follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of MERN Capstone.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MERN Capstone
theory.body: MERN Capstone offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
